site.name: PZGIF

notFound.title: That page does not exist
notFound.body: The link may be out of date. Every tool is listed on the homepage.

plan.downgraded: Set to {width}px at {fps} fps — the largest this device can hold.
plan.truncated: Trimmed to the first {seconds}s so it fits this device.

estimate.caveat: An estimate. The real size shows as soon as it exists.

errors.unsupportedFormat: This is a {format} file, which this tool does not take.
errors.tooLargeForDevice: This is longer than this device can hold at once — {frames} frames needs more than the {budgetMb} MB available.
errors.decodeFailed: We could not read this file. It may be damaged, or use a format this browser cannot decode.
errors.encodeFailed: Compression failed. Lowering Colors to {colours} usually gets it through.
errors.oom: This ran out of memory partway through. Try {width}px or a shorter clip.

browserUnsupported.noVideoDecoder: This browser cannot decode video at all, so video input is unavailable here.
browserUnsupported.noVideoEncoder: This browser cannot create MP4 files.
browserUnsupported.iosVideoBudget: iPhones and iPads do not have enough memory to convert video in the browser. GIF files work normally here.
browserUnsupported.noImageDecoder: This browser cannot read animated WebP.

actions.runDegraded: Do it anyway at {width}px, {fps} fps — about {seconds}s of GIF
actions.changeFrames: Trim the clip and try again
actions.tryOtherBrowser: Chrome, Edge or Safari on a computer can do this
